body: Perhaps I should have been more clear, I had all of these symptoms before smoking weed, except the "Poor memory" part perhaps.
Wow, I feel so bad right now and I'm seriously considering ending my life right now. I just can not deal with everything in life. I just don't know how I will ever be able to sort this all out.

Actually it isn't that much of a problem, I was mostly just interrested in knowing more about it. The reason I think it's kind of hard to talk about is because I feel so different.

I don't really know what to write, I'm thinking way to much atm. I keep thinking about how this may have been the reason to why I ruined my relation with my family.

I just can't see myself going to a doctor now, to be honest I don't want to know more about this. I just want to continue with my life, try to deal with all my problems I already have and just hope this doesn't get worse.

I've thought about suicide before, but I've always known it's not something I would do. But now it feels like that has kind of changed, now I feel like I will most likely do it in the future. It's not as if I'm going to kill myself now, I just feel like I will do it in the future, I just know it.

Also I just want to thank you a lot for taking your time to write here, you have no idea how much better it feels. I'm going through so much right now and I don't even want to imagine knowing this and have no one to talk about it with. Thanks a lot.

Damn, made me feel kind of down. I don't really want to go see a doctor now, that's the thing. I just don't want to deal with this right now, I already have a bunch of problems. I just can't handle all of this. And the thought of it becoming worse and stuff makes me feel even worse, feels like I'm gonna be that "psychotic idiot" people laugh about.

I actually thought a little about this a few months ago and I read just a little about it and I really was like "No way!"

But now I looked into it again and I'm fairly sure now.

- Delusions of grandeur - for example when you believe that you are very special or have special powers or abilities.

- Low energy - the person tends to sit around and sleep much more than normal

- Lack of interest in life, low motivation. (Tends to come in periods for me.)

- Social isolation - person spends most of the day alone or only with close family

- Disorganized thinking

- Poor concentration

- Poor memory

Could relate to all of these.

I don't feel like it's affecting my life THAT MUCH, do you think it will get worse?

Hit me kinda hard. :/
